```plato
//==
// # Curves shapes
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Evaluating plane arcs, function graphs, and polynomial pieces
//  - Evaluating the polar and figure curves
//  - Evaluating the plane spirals and roulettes
//  - Evaluating the named space curves

library CurvesShapes
{
    //==
    // # Evaluating plane arcs, function graphs, and polynomial pieces
    //
    // Closed-form evaluation of the types declared in `curves-shapes.types.plato`, plus
    // the two angle-to-point helpers (CirclePoint, RotateBy) that every circular,
    // polar, and roulette formula in the curves-2d family is written against.
    //
    // Conventions:
    //   * The canonical curve parameter is `t` in [0, 1] (the `IProcedural` domain
    //     inherited through `ICurve2D`).
    //   * Types carrying an `Angles: AngleInterval` sweep map t through
    //     `Angles.Lerp(t)`; types without one map t to `t.Turns`, one full
    //     revolution, as `curves.concepts.plato` documents for
    //     `IPolarCurve2D`.

    //==
    // # Shared helpers

    // The displacement of length `radius` at the given angle from +X:
    // (radius * cos theta, radius * sin theta). The angle-to-point evaluator
    // under every circular, polar, and roulette formula below.
    CirclePoint(theta: Angle, radius: Number): Vector2D
        => (theta.Cos * radius, theta.Sin * radius);
```
